pull_request.description: Pull request metadata recorded by the endpoint for PR-mode reviews.

agent.description: Agent attribution the host exposes: a bot author or a recognized commit trailer.

lineage.description: Present only for reviews that belong to a review lineage (PR or --since-last branch).

publication.description: Present when a publication step ran.

reason.description: Why nothing, or only the check run, was published.

failures.description: Items the host rejected; each is retried on the next round of the lineage.

cache.description: Agent result cache use; present when the agents step ran.

suppression_proposals.description: Open suppression proposals for the repository.

remembered.description: Findings removed from the main sections as remembered dismissals: the repository registry records them dismissed intentional, irrelevant or style on an unchanged enclosing symbol. Each carries its history block; never consulted by fail policies.

security_coverage.description: Catalog coverage of the security step; present when the security step ran.

council.description: Council coverage and cost; present only when the council step ran.

not_councilled.description: Selected findings not councilled because of max_findings.

refuted.description: Councilled findings the council refuted; they are not open findings and are listed here with the cited protection.

held.description: Councilled findings that presentation floors or caps keep out of the findings lists; listed with their council result and never evaluated by fail policies.

fix.description: Only for a local fix: head lines of the primary file and their full new text.

cached.description: True when the hypotheses were replayed from the agent result cache.

id.description: Identity of the instance finding when this location belongs to a class-level finding.

status.description: Lifecycle of a posted lineage finding, independent of regression state.

resolution.description: How the lifecycle status was reached: the head that fixed the finding, or why it stayed open.

verification.description: Semantic invariant: agreeing <= voters and blind_match contains one entry per configured voter; enforced by Rio deserialization and runtime validation.

history.description: Earlier record of this identity in the repository's finding registry; present only when one exists. Never consulted by state, status or fail policies.

first_seen.description: Review id that first produced the identity in the repository.

last_seen.description: Review id that last produced the identity before this review.

dismissed_in.description: Review id or pull request reference where the identity was dismissed.

fixed_in.description: Review id that recorded the identity fixed; present when previous_status is fixed, so a recurrence reads as a regression of that fix.

council.description: Council review of the finding; present only when the council reviewed it. Never carries a numeric confidence.

cause.description: Why the member abstained or did not take part.

family.description: Model family of the member, for presentation and author-family exclusion.

rounds.description: The member's answer per round it was asked; never a numeric confidence.

reason.description: Why the experiment did not run.

outcome.description: Exit outcome per version that ran.

note.description: Positions by basis and dissent, in words; never percentages.

protection.description: Artifact reference of the protection a `refuted` decision cites.

skipped.description: Fewer than min_members answered; the finding keeps its verifier result.

static_only.description: Fork pull request: no runnable artifacts and no experiments.

weight_category.description: The category member weights were looked up under; evaluation estimates them under the same.

substituted.description: Members of the author's family replaced by an allowlisted vendor of another family.

trace.description: Security finding trace from source to sink, as the security agent cited it.

missing.description: The change removed this step; its location is in base.
